svg.title: Air quality technician — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as air quality technician, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: An air-sampling unit has a tall inlet mast and round indicator beside a separate two-stage filter cartridge. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, an oval face.
